WITH solution_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM solution
    GROUP BY name
),
stack_scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, test_score as stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model = 'Stack'
),
nonstack_max AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, MAX(test_score) as max_nonstack
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model != 'Stack'
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
condition_met AS (
    SELECT sm.name, sm.version, sm.step
    FROM stack_scores sm
    JOIN nonstack_max nm ON sm.name = nm.name AND sm.version = nm.version AND sm.step = nm.step
    WHERE nm.max_nonstack < sm.stack_score
),
problem_step_counts AS (
    SELECT name, COUNT(*) as steps_with_condition
    FROM condition_met
    GROUP BY name
)
SELECT psc.name
FROM problem_step_counts psc
JOIN solution_counts sc ON psc.name = sc.name
WHERE psc.steps_with_condition > sc.cnt
ORDER BY psc.steps_with_condition DESC, sc.cnt DESC, psc.name
